summary.text: Wayne Johnson is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 41A, in office since January 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Cole Birkeland. He is an accountant and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Johnson earned an associate degree in accounting from Iowa Lakes Community College and a bachelor's degree in accounting from Metropolitan State University.
Ballotpedia says his career includes work as an accountant and ownership of two HVAC businesses.
Johnson defeated Lucia Wroblewski in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 41A and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
He serves on the House Housing Finance and Policy, House Taxes, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees.
